notice: All photographs are AI-generated synthetic images of a fictional, unbadged vehicle. They do not depict a real vehicle, person, location, license plate or incident.

generation.method: AI image generation (GitHub Copilot image_generation tool)
generation.promptRecord: The prompt fields below are faithful summaries of the prompts supplied to the image tool; the verbatim prompt text was not retained for this claim. Source hashes are exact.
generation.consistencyApproach: Photograph 1 was generated with the rejected first candidate supplied as a visual reference and re-rendered for late-November conditions (bare trees, snow on distant peaks); photographs 2-6 were generated with photograph 1 supplied as a visual reference so the same vehicle, paint, wheels, damage and setting carry across the set.
generation.importProcess: build_evidence.py --import-photos converts each source PNG to a baseline JPEG (quality 88, 4:2:0 subsampling) with no EXIF or other embedded metadata. Pixels and dimensions are unchanged.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Summer foliage in the background was inconsistent with a November date of loss. Used only as a visual reference for photograph 1; this candidate is not used.

generation.manualReview: Each image was inspected visually before import: the same ruby red unbadged crew-cab pickup in a high-desert parking lot on a sunny late-November day, with the same left rear door dent and left bed-side scrape (grey transfer) in every view that shows the left rear; no people, no readable text, blank plates, no annotations or overlays.
